text.ms:
1. (1) Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Pembangunan Kemahiran Kebangsaan (Penepian Fi kepada Pusat Bertauliah)

(2) Peraturan-Peraturan ini disifatkan telah mula berkuat kuasa

pada 1 Julai 2016.

Penepian fi

2. Fi yang ditetapkan dalam butiran 4(a) dan (b) Jadual Pertama kepada

Peraturan-Peraturan Pembangunan Kemahiran Kebangsaan (Fi dan Caj) 2016

[P.U. (A) 86/2016] diketepikan berkenaan dengan pusat bertauliah yang dinyatakan

dalam Jadual yang memohon bagi pindaan maklumat pentauliahan bagi setiap program

latihan kemahiran yang berhubungan dengan—

(a) perpindahan premis latihan kemahiran; dan

(b) premis latihan kemahiran tambahan.

JADUAL

1. 1. GIATMARA Malaysia

2. Bahagian Kemahiran dan Teknikal, Majlis Amanah Rakyat

Dibuat 21 Mac 2018

[KSM/PUU(S)600-1/2/16/1; PN(PU2)655/IV]

DATO' SRI (DR) RICHARD RIOT ANAK JAEM

Menteri Sumber Manusia

NATIONAL SKILLS DEVELOPMENT ACT 2006

NATIONAL SKILLS DEVELOPMENT (WAIVER OF FEE TO ACCREDITED CENTRE)

REGULATIONS 2018

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 72(2)(d) of the

National Skills Development Act 2006 [Act 652], the Minister makes the following

regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the National Skills Development

(Waiver of Fee to Accredited Centre) Regulations 2018.

(2) These Regulations are deemed to have come into operation on 1 July 2016.

Waiver of fee

2. The fee prescribed in items 4(a) and (b) of the First Schedule to the National Skills

Development (Fees and Charges) Regulations 2016 [P.U. (A) 86/2016] is waived

in respect of the accredited centres as specified in the Schedule which apply for

amendment of accreditation information of each skills training programme relating to—

(a) the transfer of the skills training premises; and

(b) the additional skills training premises.

SCHEDULE

3. 1. GIATMARA Malaysia

2. Vocational and Technical Division, Majlis Amanah Rakyat

Made 21 March 2018

[KSM/PUU(S)600-1/2/16/1; PN(PU2)655/IV]

DATO' SRI (DR) RICHARD RIOT ANAK JAEM

Minister of Human Resources
